applies_to: contact-control sensitivity and supplemental contact mesh cases
trigger: With KEYOPT(10) = 2, MAPDL updated normal contact stiffness at every equilibrium iteration and the corrected FKN = 0.1 trial converged to the same final response as the prior default-stiffness result.
change: Set KEYOPT(10) = 1 so the initial contact stiffness is held during the load step and requested FKN sensitivity is observable.
disposition: Retain contact_penalty_fkn_0p1_a02 as a rejected sensitivity design. All accepted contact-control cases must use revision 7.
